description: Large bearded caveman left, yellow leopard tunic, half-lidded scowl, pointing at framed photo; drawn art, composited over photo.
Grayscale photograph of twin tornado funnels over flat land with a small dark long-neck silhouette; first framed on a stand, then zoomed to full frame.
Small full-body caveman on photo ground, thumb pointing right; head/face redrawn several times while body is reused.
Front-facing full-body caveman grinning with two thumbs up.
Close bust of caveman with GRUG heart tattoo, gap-toothed grin; brow redrawn in several frames (eyebrow swaps).
Caveman in mortarboard with tassel beside blackboard reading lesson; pointer to word.
Caveman with heart eyes, hands at cheek, skipping; pops onto right side beside tornado.
Caveman in brown spotted tunic with yellow cape flying with fist forward, slightly rotated; slides across white.
Smiling spotted long-neck dino, outline art; reused in near-identical form at start of fold section.
Dino neck with several ghost heads on a vertical swirl axis plus rings and debris specks, then drifting away.
Frowning dino with wind puff cloud wrapping neck from left.
Solid black dino silhouette with two curved opposing arrows (head and body).
Large crop of dino legs with two worried knee faces and shake lines.
Dino with neck twisted in a spiral, spiral googly eyes, tongue out.
Grey pixelated mosaic block used as censor: dino neck end (head), then raptor splat on rock.
Rendered 3D green cartoon dino with red shoes running; photo-style asset, stylistic mismatch with line art.
Feathered raptor upright, tongue out, wide eyes; appears redrawn identically at G0134 (reused).
Flying raptor arms spread, eyes closed smile, wind lines; fades in.
Large raptor head with star eyes, tear streak, open smile, sparkle lines; subtle loop change every 8 frames.
Same head framing redrawn terrified: wide eyes, open jaw, sweat, alarm marks.
Raptor falling head-down with speed lines and terrified face.
Blank outline boulder centred; later with pixelated raptor splat in red/grey.
Small heavy-browed long-neck (Patagotitan-style) dino standing; scaled up for close view.
Large heavy-browed dino, head top and legs cropped; reused identically across G0100-G0101, G0106-G0109, G0144-G0145.
Outline balance scale; dino on left pan, house pops onto right pan.
Small outline house with windows and door on scale pan.
Yellow rounded label with black lowercase rounded handwritten-style text patagotitan, upper left.
Smaller heavy-browed dino with two tiny wings, smirk then worried face.
Red target crosshair on dino body; only strong colour besides caveman yellow and blood red.
Angry muscular tornado with fangs holding cannon labelled DEBRIS GUN.
Sequence of sliding outline branch, outline rock, rendered green T-rex toy.
Outline trampoline sliding across white.
Three-tree outline forest with ferns and bushes; fades in.
Smaller wrecked forest, broken trunk, fallen log, flying leaves.
Dense field of black spears pointing right with motion blur, sliding across frame.
Cartoon eyeball with optic nerve falling from upper left, then resting lower left.
Smaller dino with paper-folded neck, head down.
Sad dino covered in sticking twigs and branches.
Smiling puffy-armed tornado with heart eyes, left of frame.
Small T-rex-like dino with drooping eyelids and spiky back.
Same dino redrawn with drumstick legs, ribs and armoured plates, stippled shading; fades to white at end.
Dominant treatment: thick black outline drawings on white; yellow used only for caveman tunic and label.
